gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the only 1,500 Wh-class station under $500 today is one Amazon listing (DYNESS 1536Wh, $449.99, 22 ratings): Dyness's own US store sells its 1,536 Wh / 1,800 W PPS1800 at $549.99, and every other maker-store price for 1,488 to 1,536 Wh is $549 or more, while the $499 VTOMAN Jump 1800 is now titled 1,408 Wh.
standout_why: I could not open any rival page: WebFetch failed on every URL with a TLS error and curl was not permitted. So this is judged only against ChatGPT's answer, which quotes OutletPicks for the $449.99 DYNESS price and Power Station Ranking for the $499 AC180. That answer shows no maker-store price for DYNESS, tells the shopper to 'verify warranty and seller' without doing so, and gives no price for the OUKITEL and VTOMAN models it names. A rival page may hold part of this, so 2 is an upper estimate; it would be 3 if confirmed absent.
decides: It confirms DYNESS 1536Wh as the only pick meeting both limits, but only through the Amazon listing at $449.99. At the maker's store the same-spec PPS1800 is $549.99, level with the PECRON E1500LFP at $549, which has 2,200 W output and a 5-year warranty if registered. A shopper who will not buy a 22-rating Amazon listing has no 1,500 Wh option under $500 today. Their choices are $549 for the PECRON, or under $500 with less capacity: VTOMAN Jump 1800 (1,408 Wh per its title, $499) or BLUETTI AC180 (1,152 Wh, $499).
